I will plant maize on this small rented plot using improved seed because in Kilimanjaro I can usually get it, and I want a better harvest from the rains. I will use some chemical fertilizer, but not too much because cash is limited, and I will also add a little manure if I can get it. I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains, and I do not expect to use pesticide on this maize plot. Most of the work will be done by my family, though I may hire a few days of labor for heavy work.
